mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ${tableName} (primary_key, enterprise_code, procedure_code, procedure_name, product_or_part, product_or_part_name, model, pcs_code, pcs_name, operator_user_code, task_num, overdue_date, should_inspect_num, status, remark, main_id, batch_num, buss_number, contract_code, batch, batch_global_code, product_flag, check_items) VALUES (#{data.primaryKeyValue}, #{data.enterpriseCode}, #{data.procedureCode}, #{data.procedureName}, #{data.productOrPart}, #{data.productOrPartName}, #{data.model}, #{data.pcsCode}, #{data.pcsName}, #{data.operatorUserCode}, #{data.taskNum}, #{data.overdueDate}, #{data.shouldInspectNum}, #{data.status}, #{data.remark}, #{data.mainId}, #{data.batchNum}, #{data.bussNumber}, #{data.contractCode}, #{data.batch}, #{data.batchGlobalCode}, #{data.productFlag}, #{data.checkItems})
mapper.select: with t as (select process_main_id, a.should_inspect_num from ${inspectProcessDispatcherTable} a GROUP BY a.process_main_id, a.should_inspect_num) select b.procedure_name, b.batch_num, b.operator_user_code, d.staff_sign as operator_user_name, a.inspect_type, a.inspect_ratio, a.create_time, t.should_inspect_num, a.inspect_num, a.passed_num, a.un_passed_num, a.un_passed_deal, a.un_passed_remark, a.remark, a.inspect_user, c.staff_sign as inspect_user_name, a.primary_key, ROUND((a.passed_num / a.inspect_num) * 100, 2) as pass_rate, a.check_items, b.primary_key as primaryKeyValue, a.primary_key as reportPrimaryKeyValue, a.files from ${inspectProcessReportTable} a inner join t on t.process_main_id = a.process_main_id inner join ${inspectProcessTable} b on a.process_main_id = b.primary_key inner join ${staffTable} c on a.inspect_user = c.primary_key inner join ${staffTable} d on b.operator_user_code = d.primary_key where a.process_main_id = #{mainId} and a.enterprise_code = #{enterpriseCode} and a.delete_flag = false order by a.create_time desc

with t as (select process_main_id, sum(a.allocation_num) as should_inspect_num from ${inspectProcessDispatcherTable} a where a.process_main_id = #{mainId} and a.enterprise_code = #{enterpriseCode} and a.inspect_user_code = #{inspectUserCode} and a.batch_no = #{batchNo} GROUP BY process_main_id) select b.procedure_name, b.batch_num, b.operator_user_code, d.staff_sign as operator_user_name, a.inspect_type, a.inspect_ratio, a.create_time, a.id, t.should_inspect_num, a.inspect_num, a.passed_num, a.un_passed_num, a.un_passed_deal, a.un_passed_remark, a.remark, a.inspect_user, c.staff_sign as inspect_user_name, a.primary_key, ROUND((a.passed_num / a.inspect_num) * 100, 2) as pass_rate, a.check_items, b.primary_key as primaryKeyValue, a.primary_key as reportPrimaryKeyValue, a.files from ${inspectProcessReportTable} a inner join ${inspectProcessTable} b on a.process_main_id = b.primary_key inner join ${staffTable} c on a.inspect_user = c.primary_key inner join ${staffTable} d on b.operator_user_code = d.primary_key inner join t on t.process_main_id = b.primary_key where a.process_main_id = #{mainId} and a.enterprise_code = #{enterpriseCode} and a.inspect_user = #{inspectUserCode} and a.batch_no = #{batchNo} and a.delete_flag = false ORDER BY a.create_time desc
